clips.title: The story
paras: On Ashenvale's central island, Elune's Tear offers night elf healers a sacred means to cleanse corruption and sickness.

Elune's Tear rests on a small islet in Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Night elves believe the stone carries the Moon Goddess's purity. Corruption has turned the lake green, and twisted bog beasts roam its shores. Local herbalists and healers, including Orendil Broadleaf, seek the stone as an emergency remedy when ordinary woodland poultices cannot wash away deep corruption.
